description: From the fz-k22 investigation. A variant repro (Enum.find_index called twice with different predicates) hit a capture-count-mismatch assertion in build_codegen_closure_targets (src/compiler2/native_codegen/driver.rs:927-970, which asserts one global capture-surface per native FnId). May be a FOURTH independent symptom of the 2+-distinct-closure-shared-HOF class, OR may resolve once Slices A-C land. RE-VERIFY after A-C: run the find_index-twice repro; if still failing, diagnose whether the one-capture-surface-per-FnId assertion is too strict for a shared HOF specialization reached by distinct-capture closures. ACCEPTANCE for the whole fz-k22: the minimal 2-closure repro (Enum.find + Enum.find_value in one fn) AND enum_predicate_search fixture run GREEN on all three backends (run/interp/build) -> enum_predicate_search::{run,interp,build} leave the known-red set (11->8). Related: fz-k22.
title: fz-k22 Slice D: re-verify build_codegen_closure_targets one-capture-surface-per-FnId assertion after A-C (Enum.find_index-twice variant)
